label: Tanec · Flamenco
desc: Dupání podpatků, kroužení zápěstí, tlesknutí, otočka se sukní, hrdý postoj.
desc_en: Heel stamping, circling wrists, a clap, a spin with the skirt, a proud stance.
style_tail: , static camera, cinematic studio lighting, photorealistic, one continuous dance movement at a steady moderate tempo, highly detailed
negative: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, distorted face, extra fingers, bad anatomy, extra limbs

beats.prompt: the dancer stomps their heels on the wooden floor three times, arching them back with each stomp, and ends with their chin raised
the dancer slowly raises both arms overhead over the whole shot, wrists twisting in circular flamenco wrist-work, and ends with arms high
the dancer claps their hands sharply above their head once and snaps their face toward the camera with an intense gaze, then holds
the dancer spins once, their skirt flaring out in a wide arc around their legs, and ends facing the camera as the skirt settles
the dancer strikes a proud final stance, one hand on their hip and head tilted back, and holds it perfectly still
